+title: Restore a spilled prompt cache in MLXLanguageModel.Executor, and prove warm restores on a real model
+---
+#prompt-cache
+
+(Plan item F3, the executor side, and the real-model acceptance of F4.)
+
+## What
+
+In `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/MLXLanguageModel.swift`, `runRespond` checks out the session's entry at `:973-980` and checks it in at `:1107-1109`. After task ^w0s77dt, `checkOut` can return `.spilled(handle)`.
+
+- On `.spilled`, restore the entry INSIDE the model container (the file read needs `model.newCache(parameters:)` as templates, and the restore evaluates arrays): call `ExecutorPromptCacheFile.read(from:key:templates:)` (task ^z6av3ep), which evaluates the restored arrays. Then delete the file. Hand the entry to `ExecutorPromptCacheSlot` as today.
+- The restore is NOT on the store actor, thus the store stays free.
+- Any error of the read (a class mismatch, a corrupt file, a missing file) deletes the file and gives a cold start with one log line. It never fails the turn.
+- The plan log line (`ExecutorPromptCacheReport.planLine`) names a restore from disk, for example `source=disk`, and the time the restore took.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A session whose entry went to disk comes back warm: the reused token count is greater than 0, and under greedy sampling the answer equals a cold run of the same transcript.
+- [ ] The file is deleted after the restore.
+- [ ] A corrupt spilled file gives a cold turn that succeeds, and the file is deleted.
+- [ ] Qwen3.5 (`MambaCache` + `KVCacheSimple`) comes back warm from disk (F4).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Unit: in `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/`, drive `Executor.respond` with a small test model and a store with a tiny memory budget, thus every entry spills; assert a warm restore, the file deleted, and a cold success for a corrupt file. Follow the existing executor prompt-cache tests (for example the files that use `generationObserver`).
+- [ ] Integration: new `IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests/MLXFoundationModelsIntegration/TextGeneration/PromptCacheSpoolIntegrationTests.swift`: interleave more sessions than the memory budget holds, and show warm restores, with the method of `PromptCacheReuseChannelTests`.
+- [ ] Integration: extend `IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests/Qwen35SessionPromptCacheTests.swift` with a spill and a restore.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXFoundationModelsTests.xctest` — all pass.
+- [ ] `xcodebuild build-for-testing -project IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTesting.xcodeproj -scheme IntegrationTesting -destination 'platform=macOS'` compiles (`swift build` does not see `IntegrationTesting/`), then run the two integration suites with `-only-testing:` and record the results on this task.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
